text:
sarah_support: FYI escalation from Acme (acct: acme-inc). They started seeing p99 jump ~3.2s during their daily billing window at ~2026-03-17T14:03Z. p95 moved from ~600ms -> ~1.1s. They reported intermittent 500s for some requests. sample req ids: req_9a1, req_9a2.

autoscale-bot: alert: pool=d-acme-01 metric=scaleup-latency p99=3200ms queue_len=42 at 2026-03-17T14:04:02Z (rule=dedicated-scaleup-p99).

jia_sre: ack — can you paste the last 30m prometheus snippets and the pool config? any deploys or image changes in the last hour?

sarah_support: past 30m graphs: [metrics link redacted]. Pool config for d-acme-01 shows min_pool=0, max_pool=8, priority_quota=standard. No deploys on their models in the last 2 hours. Repro curl we ran:```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/dedicated/d-acme-01/generate -w '\nTIME_TOTAL:%{time_total}\n' -o /dev/null
# sample output during spike: TIME_TOTAL:3.24\nHTTP_CODE:200
```

mark_runtime: min_pool=0 explains cold GPU starts. attach_time metric spiked to ~2.6s concurrent with p99. Also seeing image-pull timeouts on a subset of nodes. Two suggestions: 1) bump min_pool to 2 for this pool as an immediate mitigation, 2) check node preemption events and image-pull registry throttle.

anita_oncall: applied temporary change: min_pool=2 for d-acme-01 and enabled priority_queue for acct=acme-inc. Prewarm jobs launched for 2 GPUs. Monitoring p99 now. :rocket:

autoscale-bot: action: set-minpool executed by anita_oncall at 2026-03-17T14:08:11Z. Prewarm tasks started (task_ids: warm-372345-1, warm-372345-2).

jia_sre: digging into cluster logs — found cluster-autoscaler oscillation at 14:01:50Z due to fairshare preemption loop; several nodes terminated then re-created. That caused a short window of image-pull backlog and attach retries. Also seeing ~7% attach_failures with retry latency bump.

sarah_support: customer confirms fewer 500s after the min_pool change; their p99 dropped to ~820ms at 14:25Z. They still see occasional 1.2s outliers but much improved.

mark_runtime: follow-ups: 1) add preemptive-warmup toggle for scheduled billing windows for high-SLA dedicated pools, 2) improve image-pull concurrency (we've hit registry-side rate limiting) — consider local caching in the warmup pipeline, 3) autoscaler: add hysteresis to fairshare preemption to avoid oscillation.

anita_oncall: created a short mitigation runbook in the console: steps to bump min_pool, enable priority queue, and trigger prewarm. Will convert to playbook if we need to run this more than once. :white_check_mark:

autoscale-bot: created incident INC-3723 (auto) severity=high linked_pools=[d-acme-01] at 2026-03-17T14:12:05Z.

jia_sre: for the postmortem we should grab: attach_time histograms, node lifecycle events, registry error rates, and the pool's warmup success ratio for last 48h. Also correlate with customer traffic patterns (billing window).

sarah_support: thanks everyone — I've told Acme we're doing a short mitigation and will follow up with a timeline for the autoscaler fixes. i'll update the ticket and add logs/req ids. :thumbsup:

mark_runtime: logged action items: (a) autoscaler hysteresis patch, (b) warmup caching prototype, (c) runbook -> playbook. target PRs by end of week.

anita_oncall: will monitor for 2h; if p99 > 1.5s again I'll escalate to incident commander.

sarah_support: closing this thread for now, moving to postmortem thread. Thanks team.
